The weasel springs forward and slashes down with both front claws in one quick swipe, then lands back in its stance. Its tail stays solid and attached.
The weasel staggers backward, sinks down and lies flat on the ground with its cloak over it and its tail lying flat behind, solid and fully opaque.
The weasel scurries forward quickly on its hind legs, crouched low and sneaky, its tail held up behind it.
